description: CODESYS 2.3/3, TwinCAT 2/3 and CODESYS-based OEM tools (WAGO, Schneider Machine Expert, Bosch ctrlX, Festo examples)
rule_order_evidence: artifacts/intake/stats/raw/summary.json: E034 (94 libraries), E043 (83), E004 standard-name collisions (73), OVERRIDE as identifier (42), members after the body (16), PROPERTY accessors (6), POU access modifiers (9), LIBRARY export blocks (6); then VAR_INST (17 TwinCAT 3 files), chained assignments a := b := x (301 statements in 13 CODESYS 2.3 files, 3 in TwinCAT 3; a code generation error), empty () elements in array-of-structure initializers (281 in 9 CODESYS 2.3 files), VAR_STAT (2 libraries), a semicolon after a METHOD/FUNCTION header followed by a VAR block (36 headers in 7 TwinCAT 3/CODESYS 3 files, 2026-10-27), and with 0 occurrences in code the legacy spellings END_FUNCTIONBLOCK (terminator of the FUNCTIONBLOCK of CODESYS C0098) and ELSEIF
identifier_words_evidence: CODESYS keywords are the IEC spellings with underscores; CODESYS has no CLASS or OVERRIDE keyword (OSCAT defines FUNCTION OVERRIDE and compiles in CODESYS). See rusty_compatibility/01_CODESYS3/该厂商st规范/ST规范/CODESYS3_Programming_Reference/_cds_keywords.html.
compiler_args_evidence: CODESYS defines pointer arithmetic in bytes: pData[i] := (pData + i * SIZEOF(INT))^ (rusty_compatibility/01_CODESYS3/该厂商st规范/ST规范/09_CODESYS 3：POINTER TO.html.txt; same formula in the TwinCAT 3 manual).

string.evidence: CODESYS STRING is a sequence of single-byte characters (Latin-1 in the IDE); WSTRING is UTF-16.

time.vendor_representation: TIME and TOD: 32-bit milliseconds; DATE and DT: 32-bit seconds since 1970-01-01
time.wraparound: not simulated: arithmetic and clocks use the 64-bit nanosecond range; conversions to 32-bit integers keep the low 32 bits of the vendor unit

pointer.note: POINTER TO arithmetic counts bytes (--byte-pointer-arithmetic); REF_TO and REFERENCE TO keep element scaling. Code that stores a pointer in a 32-bit integer (DWORD) assumes a 32-bit target and is reported unsupported.

unverified_calls.BYTE_TO_BOOL: RuSTy returns the least significant bit; the CODESYS result for integers is not documented in the collected manuals
unverified_calls.WORD_TO_BOOL: RuSTy returns the least significant bit; the CODESYS result for integers is not documented in the collected manuals
unverified_calls.DWORD_TO_BOOL: RuSTy returns the least significant bit; the CODESYS result for integers is not documented in the collected manuals
unverified_calls.LWORD_TO_BOOL: RuSTy returns the least significant bit; the CODESYS result for integers is not documented in the collected manuals

standard_namespaces_evidence: Tc2_Standard (TwinCAT 3) and Standard (CODESYS) are the vendors' libraries of the IEC 61131-3 standard function blocks and functions (TON, TOF, TP, R_TRIG, F_TRIG, CTU, CTD, CTUD, RS, SR, string functions).
